verses.text: A message about Nineveh: the vision Nahum of Elkosh received.
The LORD is jealous and takes revenge. The LORD brings vengeance and burns with anger. He takes revenge on those who oppose him and holds his anger against his enemies.
The LORD is patient, yet powerful, and he never lets the guilty go unpunished. His path runs through whirlwind and storm; clouds are dust beneath his feet.
He rebukes the sea and makes it dry; he dries up every river. Bashan and Carmel wither, and Lebanon’s blossoms fade.
Mountains quake before him and hills melt. The earth shakes at his presence—the world and everyone living in it.
Who can stand against his anger? Who can endure his fierce wrath? His fury pours out like fire, and rocks break apart before him.
The LORD is good, a safe place in times of trouble. He knows those who take shelter in him.
But with a sweeping flood he will bring Nineveh’s place to a complete end, and he will chase his enemies into darkness.
What are you plotting against the LORD? He will bring it to a complete end; trouble will not rise a second time.
They are tangled like thorns and drunk with wine; they will be consumed like dry straw in a fire.
Someone has come from among you who plans evil against the LORD and gives wicked advice.
The LORD says: “Though they are strong and many, they will be cut down and disappear. Judah, I have brought suffering on you, but I won’t do it again.
“Now I will break the yoke they put on you and snap your chains.”
The LORD has issued this command about you: “No one will carry on your name. I will remove the carved and cast idols from the house of your gods. I will prepare your grave, because you are vile.”

Look—the feet of the messenger bringing good news and announcing peace are on the mountains! Judah, celebrate your festivals and keep your promises. The wicked will never invade you again; they have been completely destroyed.
